svg.text: Power and signal. Hover a dot for the net-list row ID.

g.title: P01 USBC.VBUS → USB_5V — USB-C breakout VBUS to charger input
P02 DFR1026.VIN → USB_5V — charger input (4.6–5.4 V)
P03 USBC.GND → USB_GND
P04 DFR1026.GND_IN → USB_GND — charger input ground pad
P05 CELL.+ → BAT_RAW — cell holder positive lead, keep short
P06 FUSE.A → BAT_RAW — 3 A fuse, insulated holder, mandatory
P07 FUSE.B → BAT_POS
P08 DFR1026.BAT+ → BAT_POS
P09 CELL.- → BAT_NEG — cell holder negative lead
P10 DFR1026.GND_BAT → BAT_NEG — battery ground pad only; do not tie elsewhere
P11 DFR1026.OUT_5V → OUT_5V — regulated 5 V output
P12 SW.1 → OUT_5V — latching switch, rated ≥2 A at 5 V
P13 SW.2 → LOAD_5V — star point for the load branches
P14 DFR1026.GND_OUT → GND — common ground star point
P15 ESP32.VIN → LOAD_5V — via keyed disconnect J1 pin 1; own branch from the star point
P16 ESP32.GND → GND — via keyed disconnect J1 pin 2
P17 SERVO.RED → LOAD_5V — own short branch, separate from the ESP32 branch
P18 SERVO.BROWN → GND — brown or black lead
P19 C1.+ → LOAD_5V — 1000 µF ≥10 V, mounted at the servo end; mind polarity
P20 C1.- → GND — stripe side
P21 SR04.VCC → LOAD_5V
P22 SR04.GND → GND
P23 ESP32.3V3 → 3V3 — ESP32 on-board regulator output
P24 LCD.VCC → 3V3
P25 LCD.BL → 3V3 — backlight always on
P26 LCD.GND → GND
S01 ESP32.GPIO27 → TRIG — 10 µs trigger pulse
S02 SR04.TRIG → TRIG
S03 SR04.ECHO → ECHO_5V — 5 V pulse — never straight to a GPIO
S05 R1.2 → ECHO_3V — divider junction
S07 R2.2 → GND
S08 ESP32.GPIO26 → ECHO_3V — ≈3.0 V high level
S09 ESP32.GPIO14 → SERVO_PWM — 50 Hz LEDC output
S10 SERVO.SIGNAL → SERVO_PWM — orange/yellow lead
S11 ESP32.GPIO23 → TFT_MOSI — LCD pin labelled DIN
S12 LCD.DIN → TFT_MOSI
S13 ESP32.GPIO18 → TFT_SCK — LCD pin labelled CLK
S14 LCD.CLK → TFT_SCK
S15 ESP32.GPIO33 → TFT_CS — not GPIO5 (boot strapping pin)
S16 LCD.CS → TFT_CS
S17 ESP32.GPIO17 → TFT_DC — LCD pin labelled DC (sometimes A0)
S18 LCD.DC → TFT_DC
S19 ESP32.GPIO16 → TFT_RST
S20 LCD.RST → TFT_RST

svg.text: Generated from the NETLIST table in docs/WIRING.md by scripts/gen_diagrams.py — do not edit by hand.
Dots mark connections; lines that cross without a dot are not connected. Follow labels, not wire colours.
